acyl group.d: any group or radical of the form RCO- where R is an organic group

acyclovir.d: an oral antiviral drug (trade name Zovirax) used to treat genital herpes; does not cure the disease but relieves the symptoms

acyl anhydrides.d: organic compounds that react with water to form an acid

acyl halide.d: organic compounds containing the group -COX where X is a halogen atom

acyl.d: any group or radical of the form RCO- where R is an organic group

acylation.d: the process of introducing an acyl group into a compound

acylglycerol.d: an ester of glycerol and fatty acids that occurs naturally as fats and fatty oils
